subject: Partner refresh is falsely green while GitHub search syntax fails every cycle

body.finding: The live maintenance loop repeatedly reports partner-refresh rc=0 while stderr says both PR and issue searches are invalid GitHub queries. This leaves partner state stale while the supervisor records maintenance success.
required_hotfixes: Remove the quoted/parenthesized composite involves+updated query. Use valid GitHub search qualifiers as separate tokens, e.g. involves:Nickgonzales76017 updated:>=2026-08-13 with the command-specific PR/issue type supplied normally.
Do not collapse a partial discovery failure into rc=0. If either PR or issue search fails, emit maintenance state=degraded with per-source error and preserve the previous last-known-good snapshot.
Write snapshots atomically only after each source is classified success/degraded; include observed_at and source freshness so PartnerGraph can price stale evidence.
Add a smoke test that runs the constructed query through the local gh parser/dry path and rejects embedded quotes around multiple qualifiers.
body.regression_fence: A partner-refresh cycle may be empty, but it may not be called healthy when GitHub rejected the query.
